configure.title: Configure BLE UUIDs
configure.description: Leave the defaults. The integration detects the adapter's GATT layout when it connects (generic FFE0/FFE1, OBDLink FFF0, Vgate vLinker e7810a71) and only uses these values if they exist on the device.

data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID used to connect to the OBD BLE dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_read: GATT characteristic UUID for receiving data from the dongle.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands to the dongle.

abort.no_unconfigured_devices: No Bluetooth devices are visible to Home Assistant right now. The OBD adapter must be powered (plugged into the car), awake, and within range of a Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with active connections enabled.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Polling is driven by what the car is doing. Charging or driving: fast interval, modules kept awake. Awake but parked: slow interval, passive polls that never wake modules. Asleep or out of range: extra slow. Below the 12V threshold on a parked car: low-12V interval (0 = pause until you press Refresh).

data.xs_poll: Interval while asleep or out of range (s)

data_description.cache_values: Hold on to sensor values, even when there is no data available.
data_description.fast_poll: Modules are awake anyway while charging or driving, so frequent polls cost nothing extra.
data_description.slow_poll: Each passive poll is one broadcast request; it does not send keep-alives, but any CAN traffic can delay module sleep, so keep this long.
data_description.xs_poll: Used when the car did not answer or the adapter is not advertising.
data_description.service_uuid: GATT service UUID for the OBD BLE dongle. Change only if your dongle uses different UUIDs.
data_description.characteristic_uuid_write: GATT characteristic UUID for sending commands.
data_description.low_12v_threshold: If the 12V reading on a parked car is below this, polling backs off to the low-12V interval to protect the battery.
data_description.low_12v_poll: 0 pauses polling entirely until a manual Refresh.
data_description.soc_raw_empty: The dashboard hides a buffer at the bottom of the pack. Raw SOC at which the car displays 0 %.
data_description.soc_raw_full: Raw SOC at which the car displays 100 %. Used for the 'Battery charge (displayed)' sensor.
data_description.pack_kwh: Used to turn the raw-SOC slope into the 'HV battery power (estimated)' sensor. P550e: 38.2 kWh.

send_raw_commands.name: Send raw adapter commands
send_raw_commands.description: Send AT/ST/OBD commands straight to the BLE OBD adapter and return the replies. No ATZ is sent first, so adapter settings are not reset.

commands.name: Commands
commands.description: One command per list item, sent in order.

notify.name: Post notification
notify.description: Also post the replies as a persistent notification.
